evidence.result: pyftsubset 4.68.0 + brotli 1.2.1, JetBrains Mono Bold (114828 B, 976 cmap, 1168 glyphs) to 'Type & Motion 2026' (14 codepoints): TTF 3772 B, 21 glyphs, cmap equals the 14 codepoints, 81 dropped ASCII codepoints absent; WOFF2 1712 B, magic wOF2, cmap equal to TTF; all nine gating checks true; two TTF and two WOFF2 runs byte-identical; record and verify runs gave identical checks.json; variable instancing not exercised. Specimen shows subset title matches source, missing letters blank.
evidence.scope: pyftsubset to a 14-codepoint title subset as TTF and WOFF2: cmap exact, ASCII drops absent, size drops, repeat byte-identical; no varLib.instancer (no variable font in repo); macOS arm64

summary: Python library and CLI utilities for reading, building, subsetting, and instancing OpenType fonts; pyftsubset can make reproducible subsets and varLib can instantiate variable fonts.
use_when: When you need scripted font subsetting or variable-font instancing
When font file transformation belongs in a Python pipeline
avoid_when: For shaping behavior and glyph positioning checks: harfbuzz
For visual text rendering: browser or renderer

assessment.rationale: Latest upstream news reports version 4.68.0; maintained upstream and the documented automation route supports the stated job.
